entities.summary: Silvia Priscila Perales Elizondo is a Mexican model, actress and beauty pageant titleholder She was crowned Nuestra Belleza México 2005. She was a top 10 semifinalist in the Miss Universe 2006 pageant. The following year, she became the first Mexican to win the title of Miss International in 2007.
